title: Local administration of APAC (antiplatelet, anticoagulant) to the site of arteriovenous fistula (AVF) surgery to facilitate maturation of hemodialysis vascular access (Maturation)
official: A Phase II, randomized, blinded, dose selection study to assess safety and preliminary efficacy of antithrombotic heparin proteoglycan mimetic APAC (antiplatelet, anticoagulant) administered locally to the site of arterio-venous fistula (AVF) surgery to facilitate maturation of hemodialysis (HD) vascular access in patients with end stage kidney disease (ESKD) (MATURATION)
summary:
Main objective: 1) To evaluate safety and tolerability of APAC at 42 days post-surgery.
2) To investigate the effect of APAC on unassisted AVF maturation at 42 days post-surgery or at initiation of HD, if earlier, compared to control group treated with Standard of Care (SoC).
3) To evaluate the effect of APAC on the usability of AVF for HD at 42 days post-surgery or at initiation of HD, if earlier, compared to control group treated with SoC.
4) To determine the recommended APAC dose for Phase III development at 42 days post-surgery.

interventions.name: Heparin sodium 5,000 I.U./ml Solution for injection or concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Male or female, age of at least 18 years.
2. The patient must not participate in any other investigational clinical trial during the study.
3. Ability to understand and comply with the requirements of the entire study and to communicate with the study team.
4. Written informed consent using a document that has been approved by the Ethics Committee (EC).
5. If female and of childbearing potential (premenopausal and not surgically sterile) must have a negative pregnancy test at screening and be willing to use highly effective contraception from the time of screening until D42 post AVF-surgery. Highly effective contraception methods of birth control are those that achieve a failure rate of less than 1% per year when used consistently and correctly (as per the Clinical Trial Coordination Group [CTCG] Recommendations related to contraception and pregnancy testing in clinical trials, Version 1.2, 07 Mar 2024).
6. Males must be willing to use a condom and their partners that can be of childbearing potential must use highly effective contraception to prevent pregnancy 2 weeks following study drug administration.
7. Males must refrain from sperm donation from the time of the screening to 2 weeks following study drug administration.
8. Life expectancy of at least 6 months.
9. Diagnosis of ESKD (eGFR < 15 mL/min).
10. Planned creation of a new distal radio-cephalic anastomosis proximal to the carpal joint, not allowing snuff box, to be constructed with the end of the cephalic vein to the side of the radial artery.
11. RRT is anticipated to be required within the subsequent 6 months or has already started via a contralateral central venous catheter within 6 months prior to the signing of the inform consent form.
12. Contemporary pre-operative ultrasound vein and arterial mapping per local practice, confirming anatomy suitable for AVF creation, as confirmed by the operating surgeon.
13. Luminal diameter of distal radial artery and cephalic vein ≥ 2 mm and distal radial artery compressible under ultrasound pressure.
14. One or more of the following adverse factors to successful maturation of an AVF: Anatomical factors: • Wrist: artery < 2.5 mm, vein < 3 mm • Elbow: artery < 4 mm, vein < 4 mm • Poor arterial quality due to calcification Technical factors: • Depth: distance of the cephalic vein to skin predominantly > 5 mm • Length of vein for cannulation < 6 cm Patient factors: • Age > 65 years • Female • Type 1 or type 2 Diabetes mellitus • Peripheral arterial occlusive disease or other diagnosed vasculopathy • Body Mass Index (BMI) > 29 kg/m2
15. The patient must agree not to undergo far-infrared therapy during the study.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Known allergy to heparin, history of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT), or protamine sulphate (antidote of heparin).
2. Scheduled living-donor kidney transplantation within 60 days.
3. Previous AVF is not allowed in the side (ipsilateral) of the planned AVF.
4. Active malignancy (hematological or solid tumor) or treatment for malignancy within the previous 12 months with the exception of the following cancers if they have been completely resected: basal or squamous cell skin cancer.
5. Peritoneal dialysis treatment with an elective transition to hemodialysis.
6. Presence of any significant medical condition that might significantly confound the collection of safety and efficacy data in this study, including unstable cardiovascular disease, mechanic heart valve replacement (vitamin K antagonist indicated), atrial fibrillation, recent < 3 months of thrombotic episode, acute infection or an active autoimmune, including antiphospholipid syndrome, or any generalized inflammatory disease.
7. Treatment with more than one antithrombotic within the previous 10 days prior to signing informed consent.
8. Treatment with any investigational drug within the previous 30 days or investigational antibody therapy within the previous 90 days prior to signing informed consent.
9. Anemia (hemoglobin ≤ 90 g/L) or clinically significant abnormalities in platelet and white blood cell counts.
10. Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 40 kg/m2.
11. Requirement for vein transposition or superficialization to ensure successful dialysis.
